==About==

A {{i|Crusted Crawdad}} must be cooked with a {{i|Frying Pan}} equipped and over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}.
